QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: You have decided to learn the spicy expression. You must obtain a #b#t4032934##k from Nependeaths and go to #b#p2012020##k in #b#m200000000##k to learn a spicy expression.\n\n#i4032934##t4032934#  #b#c4032934# / 1#k

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Are you sure you don't want to change your mind about signing with me? You could make a killing. Oh well, shall we continue our lessons?

yes.0: Now for your eighth lesson: You're going to learn the spicy expression by eating a spicy dish. #p2012020# in #m200000000# is the person to learn from. He can't handle anything spicy.
yes.1: Gather Nependeath Fruit--not the seeds--from the Nependeath in #b#m200000000##k. Bring it to #b#p2012020##k to learn the spicy expression.

no.0: Ah... At least keep coming to class. I'd hate to see your Charm go to waste.

npc.0: Haven't you been to #b#m200000000##k yet? #b#p2012020##k in #m200000000# is well known for loving sweets. Get him to eat a #b#t4032934##k and he'll make the most delicious expression!

item.0: Ah, my mouth is dried out from eating too much bread. I sure could go for some nice refreshing fruit...
